title: Footnote Definition Has No Content On Its Line
message: A footnote definition's text must start on the same line as its label, as in `[^ref]: Text.`. For multi-paragraph footnotes, use the div syntax instead: `::: ^ref ... :::`.

notes.message: This footnote definition has no text after the colon. Quarto markdown reads a footnote's text only from the label's own line.
notes.label: footnote-def

notes.message:
For multi-paragraph footnotes, use the div syntax:

::: ^ref

First paragraph.

Second paragraph.

:::.
notes.label: suggestion
